name: pixel-sort
title: Pixel Sort
description: The outgoing scene melts downward in vertical columns of different speeds, smeared into bright streaks, and the incoming scene drops in column by column and snaps sharp. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .pxs-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.
useWhen: Glitchy, digital or music-video scene changes.
A fast cut with a strong graphic signature.
avoidWhen: Scenes with fine text that would smear unreadably.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Columns
variables.description: Number of vertical columns the frame is sliced into.

variables.label: Seed
variables.description: Seed for per-column melt amount and timing.

variables.label: Streak color
variables.description: Color of the bright smeared streaks.
